profiles.title: Mainland setup through ADDED / TAMM
profiles.overview: Use this path when the company is setting up or operating as an Abu Dhabi mainland entity rather than in ADGM or KEZAD.
profiles.whoHandlesIt: Founder, company admin, PRO or legal adviser opens ADDED/TAMM services; Yala AD records preparation tasks and official references only after the provider step happens.

preparationSteps.text: Choose the licence or permit category and confirm the activity with ADDED/TAMM.
Use the relevant ADDED services such as trade-name reservation and economic-licence issue where applicable.
Before opening the provider flow, collect the proposed activity, trade name options, office or premises assumption and the person who will own the official submission.
For employees of a mainland/MoHRE-registered establishment, keep work-permit and residence actions separate from licence setup.

unknowns.fees: Unknown in Yala AD; confirm current fees in ADDED/TAMM for the selected activity and service.
unknowns.timing: Unknown in Yala AD; do not show approval or issue timing without provider evidence.

limitations: Do not reuse this as the ADGM or KEZAD checklist.
Opening the provider page is only an opened handoff, not a submission or approval.

profiles.title: ADGM registration and post-registration services
profiles.overview: Use this path when the company is forming or operating in Abu Dhabi Global Market.
profiles.whoHandlesIt: Founder, company secretary, legal adviser or HR uses ADGM channels such as the Online Registry and ACCESSADGM; Bankable tracks owner, next action and provider references.

preparationSteps.text: Prepare business plan and documentation for ADGM Registration Authority review before application submission.
Submit incorporation through the ADGM Online Registry Solution when ready.
For visa-related services after registration, ADGM entities use ACCESSADGM and may need an Establishment Card and E-Channels account.
Separate incorporation readiness from employee visa readiness so HR can invite employees without seeing private bank or identity evidence until consent is granted.

unknowns.fees: Unknown in Yala AD; confirm current ADGM registry and government-service fees in the official channel.
unknowns.timing: Unknown in Yala AD; ADGM/provider responses determine actual status and timing.

limitations: Do not claim automatic ADGM status sync.
Do not show private employee documents to HR without specific consent.

profiles.title: KEZAD free zone setup and employment residence services
profiles.overview: Use this path when the company is selecting a KEZAD free zone or facility package instead of mainland ADDED or ADGM.
profiles.whoHandlesIt: Founder, company admin, PRO or KEZAD-facing adviser chooses the package and workspace route; HR handles later employee residence actions through KEZAD or competent-authority channels.

preparationSteps.text: Choose the KEZAD package and whether the route uses a shared workstation, dedicated office or other facility option.
Submit documents and payments through KEZAD channels; licence issue remains with KEZAD.
For employees, confirm KEZAD services such as Establishment Card and Employment Residence where applicable.
Before inviting employees, record package assumption, visa provision assumption, office/workspace location and the person who will receive provider responses.

unknowns.fees: Unknown in Yala AD; package prices, tariff items and visa provisions must be confirmed with KEZAD.
unknowns.timing: Unknown in Yala AD; KEZAD and competent authorities decide issue and approval timing.

limitations: Published package or tariff evidence does not prove eligibility for a specific company or employee.
Opening KEZAD pages is only an opened handoff.
